editorial_rules_for_agent.status_flip_requires: two whitelisted sources OR named government spokesperson on record
editorial_rules_for_agent.budget_allocation_semantic: Budget allocation = commitment, NOT delivery. Allocations move promises to in_progress or partial. Delivered = scheme operationally reaching beneficiaries.
editorial_rules_for_agent.vijay_name_convention: Mr. Vijay or CM Mr. Vijay; never bare 'Vijay'
editorial_rules_for_agent.primacy_claims_require_verification: Any promise with 'first / largest / most / only / biggest' MUST be verified against other jurisdictions. Real example: g8_aimin (Kerala beat TN by 1 day).
